simple.meaning: צׇרְעִי (Tsorʻîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Tsorite or Tsorathite , i.e. inhabitants of Tsorah.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: צׇרְעִי (H6882) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 1 Chronicles 2:53, with occurrences in 1 Chronicles.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in צׇרְעִי (H6882) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: צׇרְעִי (Tsorʻîy) / H6882 is traced through 1 Chronicles 2:53, 1 Chronicles 2:54, 1 Chronicles 4:2 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

occurrences.englishText: The families of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.
The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.
Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
